script_text: Hold your breath, Taurus — Venus is about to shake your foundation. As an Earth sign, you crave stability, but today the cosmos demands change. Venus, your ruling planet, is conjunct Pluto in your 7th House of Partnerships, dragging buried relationship issues into the light. At the same time, Mars in your 10th House of Career is squaring that Venus-Pluto conjunction, pitting professional ambition against personal intimacy. If you're taken, expect a defining moment that forces total honesty between you and your partner. If single, you will attract someone magnetic and transformative, never a casual flirtation. Mars demands you seize control of a stalled career move, but Venus warns against letting passion override practicality in money matters. A joint financial opportunity appears through a close associate, yet the fine print holds a trap. Avoid signing any binding contract today until the dust fully settles. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
